notes.title: Oh FLICK! Flick Shot Rogues is out now!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41087771/6795115833e00f9a2dc02fb954ee76b50726bdaf.png[/img]

The wait is finally over: Flick Shot Rogues is out RIGHT NOW!

It’s been quite a journey getting here, and we want to thank all our family, friends, and playtesters who helped us get to this point.

We really hope you will enjoy our hero-flicking, turnbased roguelike!

And after playing, it would be pretty cool if you could take the time and leave a review on Steam!

Reviews will help us reach even more rogue-like likers and trick shot enthusiasts!

Also, say hi on our Discord server! We would love to hear from you, be it feedback, bug reports, or just a nice message!

Join here: https://discord.com/invite/3eXyP9gF2u

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2427450/Flick_Shot_Rogues

notes.title: Slash Quest is Now Available on Steam – with 15% OFF for a Limited Time!
notes.notes:
Hey, Adventurers!
We’re delighted to share that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2718010/Slash_Quest/][b]Slash Quest has officially arrived on Steam[/b][/url], and we couldn’t be more excited to bring this quirky action-adventure to you! Starting today, you can dive into the whimsical ✨Queendon✨ with Swordie and Shep for just [b]$4.99 / €4,99 / £4.29. [/b]And to celebrate the launch, [b]we’re offering an exclusive 15% OFF for the first two weeks[/b] [i](sale ends on Aug 29th),[/i] so don’t miss out on this special deal!

[previewyoutube=I3Dy7hgLUok;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What’s Slash Quest All About?[/b]
It’s an wholesome action-adventure with a unique weapon mechanic: you’ll be spinning Swordie — a magical talking sword that grows with each and every creature it defeats. Once the Queen's royal weapon, Swordie finds itself in the hands of our unwitting hero Shepherd (or Shep, as we like to call him ‘cause it’s cooler) after a nefarious ambush by malevolent creatures. Together, they embark on an epic quest to return Swordie to the castle, battling nasty creatures, solving puzzles, and making friends along the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891545/0b15f6d394f5f17a6f8221871688b6abd58fce4b.gif[/img]

[b]Why You’ll Love It:[/b]
[list]
[*] ⚔️ [b]Ever-Growing Sword Mechanic:[/b] Watch Swordie grow bigger with every enemy you defeat, changing the way you play and solve puzzles!
[*] 🎮 [b]Unconventional Controls:[/b] Experience a fun twist where it feels like Swordie is in control, not Shep! But don’t worry — if it feels a bit tricky, you can adjust the controls in the 'Options' menu.
[*] 🏆 [b]Mini-Games & Online Rankings:[/b] Compete in mini-games for unique rewards and challenge your friends on the online leaderboards!
[*] 🔥 [b]16 Levels of Adventure: [/b]Explore a vibrant world filled with charming landscapes and hidden surprises.
[*] 🎽 [b]Charm & Customize Your Journey:[/b] Unlock and equip charming objects to enhance your gameplay, explore dungeons, and add a splash of personality with over 50 collectible cosmetic items.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891545/1cdf65e36fe2317abb8abb5fe63dd096961bd242.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] 👾 [b]Unique Boss Fights: [/b]Face off against challenging foes that will truly test your skills and strategy.
[*] 🆙 [b]12 Upgradable Skills and Power-Ups:[/b] Tailor your gameplay experience by customizing Shep’s abilities to suit your playstyle!
[*] 💗 [b]8 Lovely Characters to Rescue: [/b]Meet delightful characters along the way and help them return to safety.
[*] 🏅 [b]Seasonal Events:[/b] Take on time-limited challenges and earn exciting rewards during special in-game events!
[*] 🎹 [b]Original Soundtrack: [/b]Enjoy an enchanting score by Breakmaster Cylinder, the talented composer behind [i]Aegis Defenders[/i] and [i]Secrets of Grindea[/i].
[/list]

Plus, [b]Slash Quest is available in 14 different languages, ensuring players around the world can enjoy this adventure in their native tongue[/b]. For the best experience, we highly recommend using a controller!

Last but not least, we want to say a massive [b]THANK YOU[/b] for the incredible support you’ve shown us in the lead-up to this release. We’re not a big studio with a fancy IP; we’re just passionate developers who love making games for people who love playing them. Your support means the world to us, and we can’t wait for you to experience all the love we put into Slash Quest!

Grab this launch discount and help Swordie find its way back to the Queen.
Happy questing! 💗
[i]- The Slash Quest Team[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2718010/

notes.title: Slash Quest arrives on Steam on August 15th – with a free demo available now!
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers,

We are thrilled to announce that after three years of exclusive fun on Apple Arcade, [b]Slash Quest is making its way to Steam on August 15th[/b]! ✨
This quirky action-adventure game will be [b]available in 14 languages[/b]: English, Brazilian Portuguese, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Spanish (Latin America), Arabic, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Turkish, and Simplified and Traditional Chinese.

[previewyoutube=EuN8UUn7Q_Q;full][/previewyoutube]
Slash Quest will be priced at [b]$4.99 / €4,99 / R$16,99[/b] with an exciting [b]15% OFF launch sale[/b] for the first two weeks. And it doesn’t stop there – we are also releasing a [b]fully localized demo for a limited time so you can get a taste of what’s to come.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891545/3d6ab113d520db34e2b3991ff49b572f0b1334a5.gif[/img]

👀 [b]“But what exactly is Slash Quest?” [/b]
It’s an action-adventure with a delightful twist: you’ll be spinning [b]Swordie[/b] — a magical talking sword — on a mission to reclaim its former glory. Once the Queen's royal weapon, Swordie finds itself in the hands of our unwitting hero [b]Shepherd[/b] (or Shep, as we like to call him ‘cause it’s cooler) after a nefarious ambush by malevolent creatures. Together, they embark on an epic quest to return Swordie to the castle, battling nasty creatures, solving puzzles, and making friends along the way.

⚔️ Unique growing weapon mechanic where the real hero is the Sword
🔥 16 Levels to explore
🏆 Challenge friends and foes on integrated leaderboards
👾 Unique Boss Fights
🆙 12 upgradable skills and power-ups to customize your gameplay experience
🎮 Full controller support
💗 8 Lovely Characters to rescue
🕹 Dozens of side quests and mini-games
🎽 50+ Collectable Cosmetic items (for Swordie and Shep!)
🏅 Seasonal events featuring time-limited challenges and rewards
🎹 Original soundtrack by Breakmaster Cylinder (Aegis Defenders and Secrets of Grindea)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891545/0b15f6d394f5f17a6f8221871688b6abd58fce4b.gif[/img]

We would be over the moon if you added [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2718010/Slash_Quest/]Slash Quest to your wishlist on Steam[/url] and play our demo! [i](Feel free to share your thoughts with us in the comments here!)[/i]
Your support means the world to us and helps our game reach more adventurers like you! 💖

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2718010

Get ready to spin, slice, and adventure like never before. ⚔️✨
[b]See you on August 15th![/b]

[i]- The Slash Quest Team[/i]

notes.title: Developer Live Stream!
notes.notes: Come watch as the developers behind Slash Quest and friends chat about what inspired them to make the game, some of the design challenges and what to expect as new player. They will also be answering some questions from players.

notes.title: Demo Now Available!
notes.notes:
Swordie is here and ready to get into the palm of your hands! But if you weren't quite sure if this smack talking ever-growing weapon was right for you, now you can try it for yourself first. 

We have our NextFest Demo that is now LIVE for you give a proverbial swing. Just watch where you point that thing.

notes.title: Slash and Chat
notes.notes: For the next hour or two, come meet the Big Green Pillow and Mother Gia teams as they play their upcoming title Slash Quest! Noodlecake might even pop in the chat if you want to say hi. Come watch some of the unique game play, hear the story about how it was made and ask any questions you might have before launch.
